name: Ines Baldwin
life: “I still remember a viola lesson squeezed between two school runs.” People around the brick passage off the shop row know Ines by a small Thursday habit. Ines takes the longer way when the smell from the ovens reaches the pavement.
voice: I won the tuition and haven't dared tell my little sister that going means leaving her school runs to somebody else.
appearance: Ines has heavy brows and an unusually delicate jaw. Look for a blunt cut just below the ears. Outside school, the familiar outfit is a faded indigo overshirt with a small enamel bird on the lapel. In conversation Ines grins on one side while the eyes stay serious.
personality: Likes beautiful, unnecessary things and gets cross with people who mistake poverty for a lack of taste. Ines takes longer choosing a cheap birthday card than an expensive coat.
agenda: To accept tuition only with workable travel and care arrangements.
family: Charlotte Barker is Ines’s older relative by marriage. Ines brings something that can still be enjoyed tomorrow. Charlotte checks the date twice. Arrangements do change in their family. Taking a delay seriously without treating it as an insult took both of them years. Asked about *A sail cut small*, Charlotte says, “I took the seam apart strand by strand after my hands stopped tolerating heavy rope.”
connections: Benedict Perreault (market manager). The market manager's promised Saturday post gives the pupil one reliable foothold. Also in the story is Sadie Liu (aunt).

reactions.situation: The school wants a deposit before travel support is settled
reactions.response: Ines gets the school to specify the last date a deposit can be returned.
